svg.title: Minecraft Maze - Floor 3 - Seed: Maze11
svg.text: Transitions: 5 elevators; 3 drops; 2 optional decoy routes
E3: elevator arrival from Floor 2 (1 floor)
D2: optional drop 1 floor to Floor 2
E4: only elevator access to the finish area (1 floor)
E5: optional decoy elevator arrival from Floor 1 (2 floors)
D3: optional decoy drop 2 floors to Floor 1
